name: Camera Onboarding, Survey & Tunnelling
purpose: Everything needed before inference can start: private camera setup drafts, the SEC-01 survey record with frame-quality evidence, bounded non-recording connection checks, and the loopback-only SSH tunnel that reaches a camera endpoint from a test server.

public_interfaces.name: SetupStore (private camera draft)
public_interfaces.contract: Atomic persistence of camera drafts; an incomplete draft never starts inference; secrets are never echoed back in responses.

public_interfaces.name: SurveyStore + redacted SEC-01 report
public_interfaces.contract: Records candidate resolution, frame-quality evidence, connectivity blockers and the selected camera; report output is redacted.

public_interfaces.name: check_connection (bounded, non-recording)
public_interfaces.contract: Returns objective frame-quality evidence (resolution, contrast, sharpness) or a classified failure; never records media.

public_interfaces.name: CameraTunnel (loopback-only forward)
public_interfaces.contract: Forwards one camera endpoint over SSH to loopback with host-key verification; refuses non-loopback binds.

coupling_exceptions.reason: The setup flow starts and stops the live worker directly through the gateway-owned LiveService.
coupling_exceptions.resolution: Accept a worker-control protocol from the gateway, or move the camera configuration model into event-contracts so onboarding needs no gateway import.

coupling_exceptions.reason: The tunnel reports its state through the live-service camera model.
coupling_exceptions.resolution: Depend on the shared camera configuration contract instead of the concrete LiveService module.

acceptance_criteria: Saving an incomplete camera draft never enables inference.
A survey run produces a redacted report with resolution and quality evidence.
A failing endpoint returns a classified error, not an unhandled exception.
The tunnel binds loopback only and verifies the SSH host key.
risks: This project handles camera credentials and SSH keys: the highest confidentiality risk in the product.
Two mutual dependencies on api-gateway are declared debt; today the gateway and onboarding cannot be extracted independently.
